title: Standard Chartered Obtains IFSCA Nod for GIFT City Wealth Management Services
summary: Expands offshore wealth distribution capabilities from India's International Financial Services Centre.

blocks.title: 📰 3. 🏦 BANKING & INSURANCE NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 Standard Chartered Obtains IFSCA Nod for GIFT City Wealth Management Services. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Expands offshore wealth distribution capabilities from India's International Financial Services Centre.
Standard Chartered received IFSCA approval to offer wealth management services out of its GIFT City IBU branch.
First foreign bank to establish an onshore wealth management unit in GIFT City.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on institutional financial products, interest margins, capital adequacy ratios, and digital payment infrastructure.
